evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: NOT ASKED. No version of 'either the movers not showing up on time, or damage to their items' was delivered.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Patti raised damage concerns extensively ('some things got pretty damaged', '$4,000 cabinet that they destroyed', concerns about repair of solid wood). Nicole asked follow-ups: 'I see where you are concerned', acknowledged damage coverage. Patti raised the stairs concern ('haul my furniture up a flight of stairs'). Nicole: 'our movers are trained, moving items with multiple flight of stairs.' Patti also raised the long drive/timing concern ('staying with them or them getting to my apartment... they'll have to wait on me'). Nicole acknowledged but did not probe deeper.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: Nicole reflected concerns back: 'I see where you are' and 'I see and to ensure that I'll be providing you an accurate estimate you can depend on' — partial acknowledgment, not a full summary with 'Did I get all of it?'
evidence_quotes.promises_delivered: Nicole delivered No Worries Damage Coverage ('we do have no worries damage coverage, we provide up to $2,000 per move to repair, replace or reimburse for any accidental damages') and mentioned employee movers ('our movers are not a daily contracted workers. They are the most well vatted and professionally train movers'). No On-Time Guarantee mentioned. No permission lead-in asked before promises. Both damage protection and employee commitment were stated, but not framed as the two structured promises on the card.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: NOT ASKED. No version of 'Does that put those to rest?' or similar was delivered after promises.

top_strength: Nicole navigated a highly emotional customer with damage concerns and built trust by directly addressing the employee-mover question, confirming no day laborers and offering the damage coverage commitment early—earning a second chance ('I'm gonna give you guys a shot').
coaching_note: The Two-Concerns question was never asked before probing began, and the call routed to walkthrough scheduling without delivering the On-Time Guarantee or closing the loop on the two promises—both critical steps 3 behaviors that should have landed before logistics gathering.
